note: OWNER DECISION 8 (2026-10-24): constant output pins are dropped from the plan (no face_guard constant class). Each entry: the pins removed from the hard core and why; the RTL ports were narrowed to match. 'rename' (S81-KITS-RTLA 10-24): packed buses keep every surviving pin at its closed-view position under its new bit name (applied once per table, marked by const_rename in the table).

dsdv_gunit_l3.why: CTL row packed (S81-KITS-RTLC 10-24): ctl() bits 1..8, 13..20, 38, 40, 41, 189..275 are constant 0 on every producer (L5 / L3 / L1 rows); the seam carries {w[188:42], w[39], w[37:21], w[12:9], w[0]} (170, rename: kept bits keep their closed-view positions); L2 unpacks before the vstop inject; rw_x[511:192] were 0 at L1 (only [191:0] written): input narrowed to rw_x[191:0]

dsdv_gunit_l1.why: CTL row packed (S81-KITS-RTLC 10-24): ctl() bits 1..8, 13..20, 38, 40, 41, 189..275 are constant 0 on every producer (L5 / L3 / L1 rows); the seam carries {w[188:42], w[39], w[37:21], w[12:9], w[0]} (170, rename: kept bits keep their closed-view positions); L2 unpacks before the vstop inject; rw_x[511:192] constant 0 (narrowed); dl_a / dl_b bits 0, 4..39, 50, 51 not read (packed {dl[275:52], dl[49:40], dl[3:1]}, 237); cw_a[7:6] not read (packed {a[9:8], a[5:0]})

dsdv_gunit_l1c.why: S81-KITS-RTLC 10-24: L1c reads f_v / f_f / f_l / f_g of front 0 only (fronts 1..3 are the same L1f master: their outputs stay, open) and o_d[205] of no front: L1f o_d packed {d[245:206], d[204:0]} (245 per front, rename)

dsdv_gunit_l0.why: CTL row packed (S81-KITS-RTLC 10-24): ctl() bits 1..8, 13..20, 38, 40, 41, 189..275 are constant 0 on every producer (L5 / L3 / L1 rows); the seam carries {w[188:42], w[39], w[37:21], w[12:9], w[0]} (170, rename: kept bits keep their closed-view positions); L2 unpacks before the vstop inject (L0 relays L5/L4 rows); hp_a / hp_b [0..39], [244..275] not read: port [243:40]; cw_a / cwo_a packed {a[9:8], a[5:0]} (a[7:6] read by no gunit leaf)

dsdv_gunit_l4.why: CTL row packed (S81-KITS-RTLC 10-24): ctl() bits 1..8, 13..20, 38, 40, 41, 189..275 are constant 0 on every producer (L5 / L3 / L1 rows); the seam carries {w[188:42], w[39], w[37:21], w[12:9], w[0]} (170, rename: kept bits keep their closed-view positions); L2 unpacks before the vstop inject (L4 relays L5 rows); cw_a / cwo_a packed {a[9:8], a[5:0]} (no gunit leaf reads a[7:6])

dsdv_gunit_l5.why: CTL row packed (S81-KITS-RTLC 10-24): ctl() bits 1..8, 13..20, 38, 40, 41, 189..275 are constant 0 on every producer (L5 / L3 / L1 rows); the seam carries {w[188:42], w[39], w[37:21], w[12:9], w[0]} (170, rename: kept bits keep their closed-view positions); L2 unpacks before the vstop inject; cw_a[7:6] not read (packed {a[9:8], a[5:0]})

ot_s81sl_xrt1.why: S81-KITS-RTLC 10-24: ring bits read by nothing / constant: dl_e / dl_w [0] and [1076..1103] (ring valid is dl_*v; the top 28 ring bits are never set), dl_vb[0], ci_b[1076..1103] (TIELO), x_si[7] (max index 59); ports narrowed, names kept

ot_s81sl_xrt3.why: S81-KITS-RTLC 10-24: ring bits read by nothing / constant: dl_e / dl_w [0] and [1076..1103] (ring valid is dl_*v; the top 28 ring bits are never set), dl_vb[0], ci_b[1076..1103] (TIELO), x_si[7] (max index 59); ports narrowed, names kept; band input bi packed {B[1075:37], B[6:0]} (B[7..36] ring header fields and B[1076..] are not read; rename)

ot_s81dv_xfin.why: S81-KITS-RTLC 10-24: the S81 xfin master is fed by xrt x_si, whose bit 7 is constant 0 (max index 59) and was dropped; ot_s81dv_xfin SIW = 7 (default) takes s_i[6:0], s_i[7] = 0 inside (ot_s81dv_norm and DV benches pass SIW = 8)

ot_dsrom_su_hcpost_lane_pr.why: BF16 result o <= {hi, 16'd0}: o[15:0] constant 0 (rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_dsrom_su_hcpost.sv); port narrowed to o[31:16]; vp reads lo[31:16] only

dsfd_su_t_rxsb.why: o_r = sqrt(sp) >= 0: sign bit constant 0; port narrowed to o_r[30:0]; receiver of rxsf o_u[31] / o_u2[31]: inputs narrowed to i_u / i_u2 [30:0], rxsb uses {1'b0, i_u}

ot_s81sl_vs.why: receiver of rxsb o_r[31]; port narrowed to ra_ri[30:0], vs uses {1'b0, ra_ri}; applies to both tables of module ot_s81sl_vs (ot_s81sl_vs.json and the re-pinned ot_s81sl_vs_lfp.json + its stub LEF); receiver of ve o_y: input packed to ve_oy[127:0] (renamed like ve), unpacked at voy_c; applies to both vs tables; S81-KITS-RTLA 10-24: s_d[63] / s_d[61] = command imm[31] / imm[29], no command field (no load): port narrowed to s_d[157:0] (new [60:0] = old [60:0], [61] = old [62], [157:62] = old [159:64]); producer vp is leaf glue (soft), the two unloaded bits are removed there by synthesis.  ve_rh / ve_ah = BF16 h ({bf16, 16'd0}, hw32 / hw8 / hw4; TIELO low halves): ports packed to ve_rh[63:0] / ve_ah[127:0], new [16k+j] = old [32k+16+j]; receiver ve unpacks at its input flop

ot_s81sl_vn.why: vn y = 8 BF16 lanes in the upper halves of 32-bit words ({bf16, 16'd0}, TIELO low halves): port packed to y[127:0], new y[16k+j] = old y[32k+16+j]; receiver vq unpacks at its input flop

ot_s81sl_vq.why: receiver of vn y: input packed to y[127:0] (renamed like vn), unpacked {y[16k+:16],16'd0} at the input flop; applies to ot_s81sl_vq.json and ot_s81sl_vq_lfp.json (+ its stub LEF)

ot_s81sl_ve.why: ve o_y = {rounded[31:16], 16'd0} per lane: port packed to o_y[127:0], new o_y[16k+j] = old o_y[32k+16+j]; receiver vs unpacks at its input flop; S81-KITS-RTLA 10-24: receiver of vs ve_rh / ve_ah (packed BF16): inputs r_h[63:0] / a_h[127:0], new [16k+j] = old [32k+16+j], unpacked ({h, 16'd0}) at the input flop

dsfd_su_t_rxsf.why: u = t / (t + 2) >= 0 and u^2: sign bits constant 0 (TIELO in the raw netlist); ports narrowed to o_u / o_u2 [30:0]

dsdv_eng_rr_e.why: rco[35:32] = request sector bits [29:26] = PCBASE[29:26] (sector = PCBASE + atom[30:5], a 26-b offset; PCBASE[25:0] == 0 checked in the unit wrapper; TIELO in the raw netlist at the kit's PCBASE 0): port narrowed to rco[38:0], new rco[31:0] = old [31:0], new rco[38:32] = old [42:36]; dsdv_eng_rr_split re-inserts PCBASE[29:26].  pci[4:1] = response-chain own field, not read by the core (head reads v / tag / d): port narrowed to pci[263:0], new pci[0] = old [0], new pci[263:1] = old [267:5].  Producer u_etap_15.pco[4:1] (dsdv_eng_tap, reused by etap_01..15) keeps the field: the next tap reads own.  rco[31:25] are NOT dropped: their earlier raw-netlist constant was the csa31 slang bug (fixed in ot_s81eng_rr_n32.sv).

dsdv_bk_g.why: S81-KITS-RTLC 10-24 coordinator ruling (b) 'drop' (bk_col has no consumer in v4.8): the dsfd_selt_c vd word of the S81 bk_sel select control is {kind 4 (3/4/5/7), seg_tag 8, 145 x 0, ...}: vd[513] (kind msb) and vd[501:357] are constant 0 at the producer (raw face_guard: TIELO), and vd[0] (rst copy) has no reader in dsdv_bk_g; dsdv_bksel_c vd and dsdv_bk_g vd (VD_PK = 1) are packed to vd[366:0] = {vd[512:502], vd[356:1]} at both ends ('rename'); legacy plana / bk_col parents use dsdv_bk_g VD_PK = 0; S81-KITS-RTLC 10-25: tap_k / sink_k bits 1 / 2 (kinds K_XQ / K_XB) are never read by ot_dsdv_vstop (those kinds are excluded from tap / sink): dropped, straps packed to [5:0] = {k[7:3], k[0]} at every dsdv_bk_g instance (renamed k[3..7] -> k[1..5])

dsdv_bksel_c.why: S81-KITS-RTLC 10-24 coordinator ruling (b) 'drop' (bk_col has no consumer in v4.8): the dsfd_selt_c vd word of the S81 bk_sel select control is {kind 4 (3/4/5/7), seg_tag 8, 145 x 0, ...}: vd[513] (kind msb) and vd[501:357] are constant 0 at the producer (raw face_guard: TIELO), and vd[0] (rst copy) has no reader in dsdv_bk_g; dsdv_bksel_c vd and dsdv_bk_g vd (VD_PK = 1) are packed to vd[366:0] = {vd[512:502], vd[356:1]} at both ends ('rename'); legacy plana / bk_col parents use dsdv_bk_g VD_PK = 0
